Sep. 24, 2026


# Toyota Motor Corporation Chairman Akio Toyoda Inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame


News Release


Download all images


Toyota Motor Corporation Chairman Akio Toyoda was inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame at a ceremony in Detroit, Michigan, on September 23, 2026, alongside three other honorees.


The first article, published yesterday, looks at the significance of Chairman Toyoda's induction and the message he delivered at the ceremony. A second article, published today, looks back on Toyota's 70-year journey with America through the stories of five Toyota figures inducted into the Hall of Fame, including Chairman Toyoda and the four previous Toyota inductees.


For more details, please see the following Toyota Times articles


- Part 1 (published September 24)[An Honor Shared, a Future to Build Together: Akio Toyoda Inducted into Automotive Hall of Fame](https://toyotatimes.jp/en/toyota_news/1116.html)
- Part 2 (published September 25)[70 Years with America: The Legacy Shared by Five Toyota Hall of Famers](https://toyotatimes.jp/en/toyota_news/1117.html)

Toyota Motor Corporation works to develop and manufacture innovative, safe and high-quality products and services that create happiness by providing mobility for all. We believe that true achievement comes from supporting our customers, partners, employees, and the communities in which we operate. Since our founding over 80 years ago in 1937, we have applied our Guiding Principles in pursuit of a safer, greener and more inclusive society. Today, as we transform into a mobility company developing connected, automated, shared and electrified technologies, we also remain true to our Guiding Principles and many of the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals to help realize an ever-better world, where everyone is free to move.
